content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing an issue trying to open my [product_name] project file ([version_no]) on Windows 10. Can anyone assist me? Thanks.
I don't speak French, but I believe you may not have the correct [product_name] version. Could you upload your program as a ZIP file?
I have [version_no], but I've tested it on [version_no] and [version_no] and it doesn't work. Here is my project file.
The provided link is no longer working. The message says the requested file was deleted. Why not attach your program as a ZIP file directly in your post?
It seems the file might be corrupted. You could initiate a support request and ask [company_name] to examine the file.
The file appears to be truly broken. There are program parts that shouldn't be present. You might want to review it using Notepad++.

After checking, I noticed the file is packaged as a RAR instead of a ZIP. Inside, there's a file presumed to be a ladder diagram. [company_name] uses Java serialized data for these files, and this one seems valid as such, but once again, [product_name] appears to have corrupted the file so it can't be opened. Filing a support request with [company_name] is likely your best option. Please share how it turns out for you.
